text: Record expenses with amount, category, date, note
Persist expenses (and budgets) in a JSON file
Reject invalid amounts (non-numeric, zero, negative, nan/inf)
Report spending per category against the budget
Report is monthly: only expenses in the given month count against the monthly budget
Alert when a category reaches 80% of its budget
Alert when a category reaches 100% of its budget
Errors reported with non-zero exit and no data corruption (invalid input does not get saved)
